services.name: NĀ PALI COAST SEA CAVES RAFT EXPEDITION + SNORKEL
services.desc: December – April is the best time for Kauai whale watching! Tour Times and Recommendations Arrive 45 minutes early to check-in. Tip: The 6:30am/7:00am departure is our most popular tour due to the lighter wind conditions, calmer waters, and more dolphin encounters. PLEASE NOTE: Raft tours will include seeing and possibly entering sea caves and snorkeling, but only if the ocean conditions are safe enough to do so. Your tour's Captain will make this decision. 4.0 hours (give or take 30 minutes) Prices Kama'aina Discount $149/Adult, $129/Child (Call in to reserve 808-742-6331. To Most Popular • 4 Hours Excursion • Ages 5+

services.name: NĀ PALI COAST SEA CAVES RAFT EXPEDITION (MAY - SEPTEMBER ONLY)
services.desc: High-adventure Zodiac raft tour along the Nā Pali Coast exploring sea caves and coastal wildlife 3 Hours Excursion • Ages 5+ • No Snorkeling

services.name: PRIVATE CHARTER (Call to Book 808-742-6331)
services.desc: $5,700 You must call to book 808-742-6331. Capacity The 30' Zodiac raft may seat up to 28 passengers Maximum of 4 hours Check-in Time Arrive at least 30 minutes early. Check-in Location Meet us at the NĀ PALI RIDERS OFFICE, then drive your own vehicle to KIKIAOLA SMALL BOAT HARBOR. Departure Location KIKIAOLA SMALL BOAT HARBOR in Waimea About Your Nā Pali Ocean Raft Tour begins on our 30-foot Zodiac© rigid-hull, inflatable raft. We tour the [Nā Pali Coast](https://www.napaliriders.com/blog/na-pali-coast/). Light snacks and drinks provided. This tour may be customized to your $5,700 for up to 28 passengers • 4 Hours
